title: A Venue-Adjusted Rating System for Punjab Kings Players
dek: A strike rate at a small, flat ground is not the same as one on a slow pitch. A venue-adjusted rating puts Punjab Kings' batters on level terms.
excerpt: Adjusting for where each ball was faced changes Punjab Kings' batting order of merit. The biggest mover shifts up once venue is accounted for.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: {{ev:va-top-name}} has the highest venue-adjusted rating among {{ev:va-n}} PBKS batters since 2022, at {{ev:va-top-v}} (100 = league average for the season and venue).
Scoring at Mohali has run at {{ev:va-hf}} of the league average since 2022.
{{ev:va-mover}} moves {{ev:va-move-n}} places in the ranking once venue is accounted for.

sections.heading: Why Venue Matters
body: IPL grounds differ enormously: short boundaries and flat pitches inflate strike rates, slow surfaces deflate them. A rating that ignores venue rewards batters for where they happen to play.
Since 2022, scoring off the bat at Mohali has run at {{ev:va-hf}} of the league average.

sections.heading: The Adjusted Ratings
body: CricField rates each batter against what an average batter would have scored from the same balls in the same season at the same venues. {{ev:va-top-name}} leads Punjab Kings' {{ev:va-n}} qualifying batters at {{ev:va-top-v}}.
The chart compares venue-adjusted ratings with season-only ratings for the leading batters.

sections.heading: Who Moves
body: {{ev:va-mover}} moves {{ev:va-move-n}} places once venue is included, the largest shift in the group. His runs came at harder grounds than his raw numbers suggest.

sections.heading: Model Choices
body: Venue factors use all matches at each ground since 2022; grounds with fewer than eight matches are treated as average. Factors are for runs off the bat, so they do not adjust bowling.
The rating measures tempo, not survival, so anchors are understated.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Rate Where They Played
body: Punjab Kings should compare batters on venue-adjusted ratings, especially when judging players from other franchises with different home grounds.
The same adjustment can be built for bowlers with a venue economy factor.

seo.metaTitle: A venue-adjusted rating for PBKS batters
seo.metaDescription: Punjab Kings' batters rated against the season and the venues they played at since 2022, and who moves once venue is counted.

methodology: Built from the CricField warehouse (Cricsheet ball-by-ball data, regulation innings). Models are fitted on the warehouse itself and described in full here. Generated by scripts/editorial/engine. Rating = runs ÷ (balls × season runs per ball × venue factor) × 100; venue factor = venue runs per ball ÷ league runs per ball, 2022–2026.
